svg.title: About me
svg.desc: Noida, India. About me. I'm Dishank Jain, an AI engineer based in Noida, India. I build Python tools for semantic search, document extraction, and recommendations. I like being able to trace a result back to the input that produced it. With an FAQ assistant, that means checking which policy it retrieved. With a recommender, it means understanding why one product ranked above another. My projects bring machine learning models, Python APIs, and Flutter interfaces together.
